name: Two-sentence summary
description: Summary must cover three named points and stay within two sentences
prompt:
Summarize the following update in at most two sentences. Cover all three points: the outage cause, the affected region, and the fix date.

Update: On Tuesday the payments service went down for 40 minutes because a config change broke the database pool. Only customers in the EU region were affected. The team rolled the change back and will ship a permanent fix on Friday, after a staged rollout.
